name: Ho-Oh

atk.x: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

fl: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

name: Reshiram

atk.x: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
If Zekrom is on your Bench, this attack does 80 more damage.

fl: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Kyogre

atk.x: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck, and then choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each Energy card you discarded in this way to each of those Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

fl: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Palkia

atk.x: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overdrive Smash attack does 80 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

ab.x: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Stadium cards from their hand.

fl: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Pikachu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

fl: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Flying Pikachu V

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

ru: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Flying Pikachu VMAX

atk.x: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

ru: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Surfing Pikachu V
ru: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Surfing Pikachu VMAX

atk.x: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

ru: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Zekrom

atk.x: If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it.
If Reshiram is on your Bench, this attack does 80 more damage.

fl: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Mew

ab.x: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal an Item card you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

fl: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Xerneas

atk.x: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

fl: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Cosmog

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

fl: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

name: Cosmoem

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

fl: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

name: Lunala

atk.x: Double the number of damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.
This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

fl: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

name: Zacian V

atk.x: This attack does 30 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

ab.x: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ru: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Groudon

atk.x: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. This attack does 80 damage for each Energy card you discarded in this way.

fl: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Zamazenta V

ab.x: All of your Fighting Pokémon take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Growl of the Shield Ability at a time.

ru: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Yveltal

atk.x: Discard up to 3 Special Energy from your opponent's Pokémon.

fl: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Dialga

atk.x: Put a card from your discard pile into your hand.
This attack does 20 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon.

fl: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Solgaleo

atk.x: Attach up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

ab.x: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.

fl: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."

name: Lugia

atk.x: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.
During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

fl: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

ru: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.
